title: Transport of the strict counit-unit complex sequence to the derived localization triangle
statement: Fix ell, E, Base b and Operations o of def-sp-tower-shriek-data. For any closed immersion i:Z->T and complementary quasi-compact open immersion a:U->T, LocalizationData b o i a exists: the closed pushforward is exact, and for every bounded-below complex C of strict coefficient systems the specified termwise derived open counit and closed unit extend to one distinguished triangle. Derived evaluation at every n sends that same triangle, including the connecting morphism, to a distinguished finite coefficient triangle.

proof.text: Use tower_ordinary_localization for the specified ordinary counit-unit sequence and right exactness of closed pushforward. Closed pushforward is left exact as the ordinary right adjoint. Apply the three additive exact endofunctors open-pull-then-extension, identity, and closed-pull-then-push termwise to an arbitrary cochain representative K of C. The given ordinary short exact sequence in each degree makes the resulting short complex of complexes short exact.

Apply DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished. For each of the three exact functors F, use F.mapDerivedCategory.mapIso(Q.objObjPreimageIso C).symm followed by F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app K. Localization.liftNatTrans_app and naturality prove the two arrow squares for deriveMap. Transport the SES connecting morphism by these three isomorphisms; Triangle.isoMk proves the transported triangle distinguished. This works on the unbounded derived category and needs no injective or bounded representative.

Conjugate the resulting triangle by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso for the open and closed composites and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso for the middle vertex. Open.counit_termwise identifies the first arrow; the second is exactly the displayed localized ordinary unit. Transport the boundary by e3.inv followed by the old boundary and shift(e1.hom). Triangle.isoMk and cancellation of isomorphisms prove distinguishedness with these precise arrows.
Each Ev is the termwise derived functor of exact evaluation, with its canonical shift comparison and triangulated instance. Apply map_distinguished to the same triangle, retaining its connecting map.
